name: web-cream-ai-writing-landing-with-textured-gradient-cards
title: Cream AI writing tool with serif headline, hand-drawn underline and three painterly gradient feature cards
whatItIs: A warm off-white page with a floating pill nav, a chip, a large light serif headline with a lavender hand-drawn underline, black and white buttons, and three large cards with textured orange, blue and purple backgrounds holding UI snippets (suggestions, rephrase, tone options).
whatItMeans: Warm and craft-like; painterly textures make an AI tool feel human.
techniques: Use serif for the hero headline on cream.
Give feature cards richly textured single-hue backgrounds.
Float small UI cards over them.

vocabulary.definition: A brush-like surface on a background.
A loose stroke under a headline.
